theory.claim: Autonomous capacity depends on resolved uncertainty, self-verification, task breadth and coupling
theory.success_model: P(success) ~ (1-q)^B where B is number of consequential decisions; q depends on depth, verification, model/harness capability and coupling
theory.leverage_metric: accepted independent engineering work / (human planning + interventions + final review time)
theory.status: proposed, uncalibrated and not empirically validated
research_questions: Does depth independently improve reliable autonomous completion?
Does verification matter more than depth?
Is there an interaction between depth and verification?
How does breadth reduce the probability of no-intervention success?
